title: Week 12 — Study Space Challenge practice
status: Draft practice questions; teacher review required
instructions: Public self-assessment based on this week's lesson; not a confidential FiiCode examination.

questions.prompt: What is the Study Space Challenge's target label?
options: One of avoid, consider or good
questions.explanation: The output is one of three synthetic suitability classes.

questions.prompt: Which value is a feature rather than the target?
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi strength is one of five input measurements.

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes the classroom dataset?
options: It is an official FiiCode dataset
It is a reproducible synthetic simulation
questions.explanation: The example is simulated and independent of the actual competition.

questions.prompt: How many labelled training rows are available?
questions.explanation: The 240-row artificial dataset is split into 150 training, 45 validation and 45 test rows.

questions.prompt: What is the validation set primarily used for?
options: Publicly declaring a final independent score
Proving what every real pupil prefers
questions.explanation: Validation is for model selection; the final test is reserved.

questions.prompt: The training class frequencies tie. How is the constant label selected?
questions.explanation: All three training classes have 50 rows; alphabetical tie-break returns avoid.

questions.prompt: The constant baseline gets 15 of 45 validation labels right. What is its accuracy?
Which action invalidates the independence of the final test?
options: Choosing k from final test results
questions.explanation: Final-test feedback must not be used to choose model settings.

questions.prompt: Select ALL checks that help guard against unreliable splits.
options: Check for duplicate input examples across splits
Verify feature ranges and required fields
Insert the test labels into training
questions.explanation: Duplicates and invalid fields can undermine the exercise.

questions.prompt: Select ALL claims supported by this practice benchmark.
options: It includes no real student records
Its three labels are artificially balanced
It is a validated school booking service
It establishes actual room comfort with known accuracy
questions.explanation: The data are synthetic and do not establish real-world service performance.
